text.title: Activation Framework Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the activation spec: one activation event with a window in days, its D30 retention comparison on a closed cohort, a baseline over at least four closed signup-week cohorts, a funnel whose every step maps to a tracked event or is marked uninstrumented, drop-offs ranked by absolute users lost, an ICE-scored experiment backlog (integers 1-10, mean to two decimals, sorted descending) where every experiment names its step, metric, baseline and ship threshold, and a weekly closed-cohort dashboard on the same window. Validator at scripts/validate-activation-framework.py enforces it, including the cohort-closure and ICE arithmetic.

required.field: `name` (a tracked event name, snake_case) and `window_days` from signup (r-single-activation-event-with-window)

`cohort` label, `performed` and `not_performed` each with `users` and `d30_retention`, `correlational_note: true`; the performed group's retention must be higher (r-event-validated-against-d30-retention)

`data_cutoff` and `cohorts[]` (at least 4) each with `signup_week_start`, `signups`, `activated`, `activation_rate`; every cohort closed, i.e. week end plus `window_days` before `data_cutoff` (r-baseline-before-experiments)

ordered steps from signup to the activation event; `status: instrumented` with `event`, `entered`, `completed`, or `status: uninstrumented` with `instrumentation_task` and no figures (r-funnel-steps-map-to-events)
one entry per instrumented step: `step`, `users_lost` = entered minus completed, `relative_drop`; sorted by `users_lost` descending (r-dropoffs-ranked-by-absolute-loss)

each with `name`, `funnel_step`, `hypothesis`, `primary_metric`, `baseline_value`, `ship_threshold_lift`, `impact`, `confidence`, `ease` (integers 1-10) and `ice` = mean to two decimals; sorted by `ice` descending (r-ice-integer-scale-and-formula, r-experiment-names-step-metric-threshold)
`cadence: weekly`, `closed_cohorts_only: true`, `window_days` equal to the activation event's, `segment_by` including `acquisition_channel`, `series_id` (r-dashboard-reports-closed-cohorts-weekly)

forbidden.pattern: `activation_event.name` that is a phrase ("user sees value") or several events joined by "or" — vague-activation-event
a baseline cohort whose `signup_week_start` + 6 days + `window_days` is not before `data_cutoff` — open-cohort-in-baseline
a funnel step with `status: uninstrumented` carrying `entered` or `completed`, or an instrumented step with no `event` — funnel-drawn-from-ui
`dropoff_priorities` ordered by `relative_drop`, or `users_lost` not equal to entered minus completed — percentage-only-ranking
`impact`, `confidence` or `ease` outside 1-10 or non-integer, `ice` not equal to the rounded mean, or a backlog not sorted by `ice` — ice-scores-unreproducible
an experiment with no `funnel_step`, `baseline_value` or `ship_threshold_lift` — r-experiment-names-step-metric-threshold

list.item: `activation_event.name` is one tracked event in snake_case and `window_days` is set (r-single-activation-event-with-window).
`d30_validation` shows both groups with sizes, the performed group's D30 retention is higher, and `correlational_note` is true (r-event-validated-against-d30-retention).

`baseline.cohorts` has at least 4 entries, each with `signup_week_start` + 6 days + `window_days` before `data_cutoff`, and `activation_rate` = `activated` / `signups` to three decimals (r-baseline-before-experiments).
Every funnel step is instrumented with an event and figures, or uninstrumented with a task and no figures (r-funnel-steps-map-to-events).
`dropoff_priorities` covers the instrumented steps, `users_lost` = `entered` - `completed`, sorted by `users_lost` descending (r-dropoffs-ranked-by-absolute-loss).
Every experiment's `ice` equals `round((impact + confidence + ease) / 3, 2)` as `templates/ice.py` computes it, and the backlog is sorted by `ice` descending (r-ice-integer-scale-and-formula).
Every experiment names an existing funnel step, a metric, a baseline value and a ship threshold (r-experiment-names-step-metric-threshold).

`dashboard.window_days` equals `activation_event.window_days`, closed cohorts only, weekly, segmented by acquisition channel, with a `series_id` that changes when the event or window changes (r-dashboard-reports-closed-cohorts-weekly).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field arithmetic.
